message.content: The agent set up the git user with password "password", started sshd on port 22, created the bare repo /git/project with a post-receive hook deploying main to /var/www/html and dev to /var/www/dev, and confirmed nginx serves HTTPS on 8443 via the pre-seeded self-signed cert (404s expected pre-push); it then found no sshpass/expect/paramiko and failed to apt-install sshpass, leaving end-to-end push testing unresolved.
